Package arcade.potts.agent.module

Class PottsModuleProliferationVolumeBasedDivision

java.lang.Object
arcade.potts.agent.module.PottsModule
arcade.potts.agent.module.PottsModuleProliferation

All Implemented Interfaces:
Module
Direct Known Subclasses:
PottsModuleFlyGMCDifferentiation
public abstract class PottsModuleProliferationVolumeBasedDivision extends PottsModuleProliferation
Implementation of PottsModule for agents that divide upon reaching a volume threshold without any cell-cycle duration requirements.

    • updateCellVolumeBasedGrowthRate

      public void updateCellVolumeBasedGrowthRate(double volume, double referenceVolume)
      Updates cellGrowthRate from a power-law relationship between current volume and a reference volume.

      The updated rate is 

       cellGrowthRate = cellGrowthRateBase * (volume / referenceVolume)^growthRateVolumeSensitivity

      The reference volume is the cell volume at which the basal growth rate is recovered. In the simplest case this can be the cell's critical volume, but users may use another biologically motivated reference such as an equilibrium or population-averaged volume.

      Parameters:
      volume - the current volume used in the growth-rate scaling
      referenceVolume - the reference volume that defines the baseline growth-rate scale
